page.overview:
Who is Hector?

Hector, also known by his ring name Brute Bomber, is a character from Final Fantasy XIV, introduced in the expansion Dawntrail. He is the champion of the light-heavyweight division of the Ascension Arcadia Championship.

Hector used the soul of a Bomb King and was known for fighting dirty, causing many fighters to be carried into the infirmary. During the fight with the Warrior of Light, Hector appeared to use illegal substances yet still lost. This victory made the Warrior the new champion of the light-heavyweight division, with Yaana being amazed that a newcomer without a regulator was able become champion of the division.

During the coronation ceremony for the new champion, Hector interrupted the event by invading the stage. He claimed the Warrior's victory was a hoax, since they fought with seven others. Hector insisted they settle it one-on-one right there, and activated his feral soul. Hector charged at the Warrior of Light, but before he could hit them Hector was knocked out by a bolt of lightning of Eutrope..}}

When Yaana and Neyuni arrived with the Warrior of Light, they warned Hector about the dangers of using feral souls. They found Hector surrounded by his kittens and Retsarra paying a visit. Retsarra revealed about their past and left to let Yaana talk to Hector. Neyuni's examination confirmed the worst—his soul already showed signs of psychonekrosis. Though Yaana urged him to retire before the disease worsened, Hector rejected their warnings in anger. Unknown to they, Retsarra had listened to the entire conversation, leaving quietly while Hector struggled to accept the truth..}}
